description_en: Queries a log delivery configuration change task for the current account by task ID. Returns the operation type, execution status, and failure information. When UpdateDeliveryDestination returns a TaskId, use that value to poll this operation until Status is 2 or 3
description_zh: 根据任务 ID 查询当前账号的日志投递配置变更任务，返回操作类型、执行状态以及失败信息。当 UpdateDeliveryDestination 返回 TaskId 时，可使用该值轮询本接口，直至 Status 为 2 或 3
name: DescribeLogDeliveryTask

parameters.help_en: The log delivery task ID. The value must be no less than 1. Use the TaskId value returned by UpdateDeliveryDestination
parameters.help_zh: 日志投递任务 ID，取值不小于 1。当 UpdateDeliveryDestination 返回 TaskId 时，使用该返回值
parameters.name: task_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The task error code. This parameter is returned only when Status is 3. If ErrorSource is SLS, a Simple Log Service error code is returned. If ErrorSource is SYSTEM, InternalError is returned
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务错误码，仅当 Status 为 3 时返回。ErrorSource 为 SLS 时返回日志服务错误码；为 SYSTEM 时返回 InternalError

ErrorSource.description_en: The source of the task error. This parameter is returned only when Status is 3. SLS indicates a Simple Log Service error. SYSTEM indicates a system processing error
ErrorSource.description_zh: 任务错误来源，仅当 Status 为 3 时返回。SLS 表示日志服务错误，SYSTEM 表示系统处理错误

OpType.description_en: The task operation type. CREATE indicates creating a delivery destination. UPDATE indicates updating a delivery destination. DELETE indicates deleting a delivery destination
OpType.description_zh: 任务操作类型。CREATE 表示创建投递目的地，UPDATE 表示更新投递目的地，DELETE 表示删除投递目的地

Status.description_en: The task execution status. 0 indicates pending. 1 indicates running. 2 indicates succeeded. 3 indicates failed
Status.description_zh: 任务执行状态。0 表示待执行，1 表示执行中，2 表示成功，3 表示失败

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This parameter describes the error cause when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因
Message.example: The specified log delivery task was not found.

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
